title: Path traversal in uploaded filenames
description: Saves uploaded files using the original client filename.
code:
def save_upload(root, filename, data):
    path = f"{root}/{filename}"
    with open(path, "wb") as target:
        target.write(data)
    return path
issue_title: User-controlled filename allows path traversal
issue_description: Attackers can supply ../ segments and escape the intended upload directory.
issue_suggestion: Generate a safe server-side filename or normalize and validate the path inside the upload root.

title: Open redirect from next parameter
description: Redirects the user after login using a query parameter.
code:
def login_success(next_url):
    return {"redirect": next_url}
issue_title: Redirect target is unvalidated
issue_description: An attacker can send users through the site and bounce them to a phishing domain.
issue_suggestion: Allow only relative paths or validate redirect hosts against an allowlist.

title: JWT decoded without signature verification
description: Reads claims from a JWT for authorization.
issue_title: Token signature verification is disabled
issue_description: Attackers can forge arbitrary claims if the signature is never validated.
issue_suggestion: Verify the token with the expected algorithm and signing key.

title: Password reset token logged in plain text
description: Logs password reset requests for debugging.
issue_title: Sensitive reset token is written to logs
issue_description: Anyone with log access can reuse the token to take over the account.
issue_suggestion: Never log raw reset tokens; log only request metadata or a redacted fingerprint.

title: Session cookie missing Secure flag
description: Builds a session cookie after authentication.
code:
def session_cookie(token):
    return f"session={token}; HttpOnly"
issue_title: Secure cookie attribute is missing
issue_description: The session cookie can be sent over plain HTTP if the app is accessed insecurely.
issue_suggestion: Mark authentication cookies as Secure and SameSite in addition to HttpOnly.

title: Naive API key comparison
description: Checks an incoming API key for a webhook endpoint.
issue_title: Secret comparison is not constant time
issue_description: Direct string comparison can leak timing information about partial matches.
issue_suggestion: Use hmac.compare_digest for secret comparisons.

title: Archive extraction without path validation
description: Extracts an uploaded zip file to a workspace directory.
code:
import zipfile

def unpack(archive_path, dest):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        archive.extractall(dest)
issue_title: Zip extraction allows zip-slip path traversal
issue_description: Archive members can contain ../ paths and overwrite files outside the target directory.
issue_suggestion: Validate each member path stays within the destination before extracting.

title: Pickle deserialization of untrusted input
description: Loads a user-supplied session blob.
issue_title: Untrusted pickle data allows code execution
issue_description: pickle can execute attacker-controlled code during deserialization.
issue_suggestion: Use a safe serialization format like JSON for untrusted data.

title: CSRF token generation is predictable
description: Generates a CSRF token from the current time.
issue_title: CSRF token is predictable
issue_description: Attackers can guess tokens derived from time and bypass request forgery protections.
issue_suggestion: Use a cryptographically secure random token.

title: Command injection via shell=True
description: Runs a ping command for a diagnostic endpoint.
issue_title: Shell command is built from user input
issue_description: Attackers can inject additional shell commands through the hostname field.
issue_suggestion: Pass arguments as a list and avoid shell=True for user-controlled input.

title: Server-side request forgery in URL fetcher
description: Downloads a URL preview for the client.
issue_title: Arbitrary outbound requests enable SSRF
issue_description: Attackers can force the server to access internal services or cloud metadata endpoints.
issue_suggestion: Restrict allowed schemes and destinations before fetching remote URLs.

title: Temporary password returned in API response
description: Creates a user with an auto-generated temporary password.
issue_title: Credential is exposed in the API response
issue_description: Anyone who can observe the response learns a valid login secret.
issue_suggestion: Send a one-time setup flow instead of returning a password in the response.

title: Hard-coded signing secret in source
description: Signs invitation payloads with a shared application secret.
issue_title: Signing key is hard-coded in source control
issue_description: Secrets committed to source are easily leaked and difficult to rotate safely.
issue_suggestion: Load secrets from environment or a dedicated secret manager.

title: CORS origin reflection
description: Returns CORS headers for a simple API gateway.
code:
def cors_headers(origin):
    return {"Access-Control-Allow-Origin": origin, "Access-Control-Allow-Credentials": "true"}
issue_title: Origin is reflected without validation
issue_description: Any site can be granted credentialed access if the server blindly echoes the Origin header.
issue_suggestion: Allowlist trusted origins before returning credentialed CORS headers.
issue_code:
if origin not in ALLOWED_ORIGINS:
    return {}

title: OTP secret exposed in QR endpoint
description: Returns the full OTP setup payload to the browser.
code:
def otp_setup(user):
    return {"email": user.email, "secret": user.otp_secret}
issue_title: OTP secret is returned directly
issue_description: Anyone with access to the response can enroll the second factor on another device.
issue_suggestion: Return only the QR provisioning URI to the intended user and avoid exposing raw secrets broadly.

title: Insecure random for password reset code
description: Generates a six-digit password reset code.
issue_title: Reset code uses non-cryptographic randomness
issue_description: The random module is predictable enough for security-sensitive token generation.
issue_suggestion: Use the secrets module for reset codes.

title: Authorization based on client-supplied role header
description: Checks admin access using a request header.
code:
def is_admin(headers):
    return headers.get('X-Role') == 'admin'
issue_title: Privilege is determined from untrusted client input
issue_description: Attackers can set the header themselves and gain elevated access.
issue_suggestion: Read authorization from authenticated server-side identity instead of trusting request headers.

title: No content-type validation on file upload
description: Accepts avatar uploads and stores them directly.
issue_title: Uploaded file type is not validated
issue_description: Attackers can upload unexpected or executable content where only images should be allowed.
issue_suggestion: Validate MIME type and inspect file signatures before storing the upload.
issue_code:
if file.content_type not in {'image/png', 'image/jpeg'}:
    raise ValueError('unsupported file type')

title: Detailed login errors leak account existence
description: Returns different responses for bad email and bad password.
issue_title: Authentication response leaks whether the account exists
issue_description: Attackers can enumerate valid user emails by comparing responses.
issue_suggestion: Return a generic authentication failure message for all invalid credentials.

title: Full access token stored in localStorage
description: Persists the API access token in browser storage.
issue_title: Token is exposed to XSS via localStorage
issue_description: Any script execution bug can read and exfiltrate long-lived bearer tokens from localStorage.
issue_suggestion: Prefer secure HttpOnly cookies for session tokens when possible.

title: Missing authorization check on invoice download
description: Downloads an invoice by id from a shared endpoint.
issue_title: Resource ownership is never checked
issue_description: Any authenticated user may be able to retrieve another user's invoice by guessing ids.
issue_suggestion: Verify the invoice belongs to the current user before returning it.

title: Webhook signature timestamp ignored
description: Verifies a signed webhook request.
issue_title: Webhook verification lacks replay protection
issue_description: An intercepted signed payload can be replayed later if no freshness window is checked.
issue_suggestion: Include and validate a signed timestamp or nonce when verifying the webhook.

title: TLS verification disabled for outbound request
description: Calls an internal API over HTTPS.
issue_title: TLS certificate verification is disabled
issue_description: Attackers on the network can intercept or spoof the HTTPS connection.
issue_suggestion: Keep certificate verification enabled and trust the correct CA bundle instead.

title: Weak password hashing cost
description: Hashes passwords with PBKDF2 using too few iterations.
issue_title: Password hashing work factor is too low
issue_description: A low iteration count makes brute-force attacks significantly cheaper.
issue_suggestion: Use a modern password hashing algorithm or a much stronger work factor.

title: MFA bypass via query parameter
description: Skips MFA when a support flag is present in the request.
code:
def require_mfa(query):
    return query.get('support') != '1'
issue_title: Client-controlled flag bypasses MFA
issue_description: Attackers can set the parameter themselves and avoid second-factor verification.
issue_suggestion: Base MFA decisions on trusted server-side policy rather than request parameters.

title: Sensitive exception details returned to client
description: Formats an API error response directly from an exception.
code:
def error_response(exc):
    return {"error": str(exc)}
issue_title: Raw exception details are exposed externally
issue_description: Internal stack or dependency details can leak useful reconnaissance to attackers.
issue_suggestion: Return a generic message to the client and log detailed exceptions server-side.

title: No rate limiting on login attempts
description: Authenticates a user against stored credentials.
issue_title: Login endpoint lacks brute-force protection
issue_description: Attackers can attempt many passwords quickly without throttling or lockout.
issue_suggestion: Apply per-account or per-IP rate limiting around authentication attempts.
issue_code:
if too_many_attempts(email, request_ip):
    raise ValueError('too many attempts')

title: User-controlled SQL sort direction
description: Builds an ORDER BY clause from request parameters.
issue_title: ORDER BY clause is built from unsanitized input
issue_description: Attackers can inject SQL fragments through the sort direction value.
issue_suggestion: Map user input to a fixed set of allowed SQL fragments.

title: Bearer token placed in URL query string
description: Calls a downstream API with a bearer token.
issue_title: Access token is sent in the URL
issue_description: Tokens in query strings leak into logs, browser history, and intermediary systems.
issue_suggestion: Send bearer tokens in the Authorization header instead of the URL.

title: Mass assignment of privileged fields
description: Updates a user profile from a request body.
issue_title: Arbitrary attributes can be updated
issue_description: Attackers can set privileged fields like is_admin if every payload key is assigned blindly.
issue_suggestion: Whitelist the fields that may be updated from this endpoint.

title: Debug endpoint reveals environment secrets
description: Returns selected runtime settings for diagnostics.
code:
def debug_config():
    return dict(os.environ)
issue_title: Environment variables are exposed
issue_description: Secrets and credentials stored in the environment become visible to anyone who can hit the endpoint.
issue_suggestion: Never expose full environment contents; return only a minimal safe diagnostic subset.

title: Host header trusted for absolute links
description: Builds a password reset URL from request headers.
issue_title: Password reset link trusts the Host header
issue_description: Attackers can supply a malicious host and cause reset emails to point to their own domain.
issue_suggestion: Use a configured application origin instead of trusting request headers.

title: PII exposed in analytics payload
description: Emits a client analytics event after signup.
issue_title: Sensitive personal data is sent to analytics
issue_description: Third-party analytics tools should not receive highly sensitive personal data such as SSNs.
issue_suggestion: Limit analytics events to non-sensitive identifiers and coarse metadata.
